scope_statement: Add deterministic product-workflow metrics to product audit or a dedicated product audit surface, reporting progress/gates/blockers/evidence links with bounded metadata only.
discovery_evidence: context_query:product workflow metrics audit status gates blockers evidence links harness_audit product audit
privacy_note: report stores only scope, model assignment, command names, commit hashes, and blocker state; it must not store raw prompts, raw transcripts, file bodies, secrets, generated briefs, or customer-identifying data
